Quest Location:
God of the Depths Bonus Zone
Quests Begun From:
Holothurian
Requirements:
Must have completed the '
Mopping Up
' quest.
Note:
This quest can only be completed
once
per day.
Frenzy Feast
A manifestation of the new God of the Depths has appeared on sacred ground. This is where Kathool was reborn, and it is where your will to survive will be tested. Dive into the coldest and darkest corner of the sea floor, and ready your hands and teeth. Triumph over Kathool's challenge and enjoy the feast. If you bring back a morsel, I would be willing to share Adeptus relics of great interest.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
Congratulations on your triumph. Though this was a mere manifestation of Kathool, it is a particularly large one that many of the Adepti would perish against. Are you the epitome of the evolution we strive to attain, or do you hold some sort of other special significance to the God of the Depths? I sense that Kathool was pleased by this exchange of violence, and that it will put grander games into play for your mutual entertainment.
Items Required:
Sacrosanct Morsel x1
Dropped by
God of the Depths
Rewards:
250,000 Gold
500,000 Exp
Items:
Adeptus Relic
x1
Thanks to Tempu.

Quest Location:
Sunken City
Quests Begun From:
Holothurian
Amensalism
Mutualism
Symbiogenesis
You recognize the Necro Adipocere that Kathool sent to the sunken city. I can sense it through our connection to the depths. They stir fascinating emotions within you. Please, feel free to partake in them or destroy them. All visitors are welcome to.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
The God of the Depths sent the Necro Adipocere here as a gift and a lure. Hungry creatures will smell them and flock, finding themselves food and a new nest. Some will burrow into the Necro Adipocere, slowly eating them from the inside out.
Items Required:
Blubber Ball x6 (Stacks up to 30)
Dropped by
Necro Adipocere (Level 68)
Rewards:
2,000 Gold
4,000 Exp
Items:
Sea Creature Membrane
x1
Requirements:
Must have completed the previous quest.
We're surprised that Merdraconians set aside their pride, and asked to partake in the feast. They've fused with my brethren, transforming into Merdrathoolians. Hmm, they wish to fuse with you as well. I imagine you'll reject them.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
Those Merdrathoolians are quite presumptuous, believing that they are worthy of becoming your eyes and limbs. They'll learn that even considering such a thing is blaspheming against the God of the Depths.
Items Required:
Merdrathoolian Eye x12 (Stacks up to 60)
Dropped by
Merdrathoolian (Version 1)
Rewards:
2,000 Gold
4,000 Exp
Items:
Sea Creature Membrane
x1
Requirements:
Must have completed the previous quest.
A mollusk and a lamprey feasted on the remains of the sunken city's princess. They fused, becoming the Nereid Princess. She's anxiously preparing herself for an audience with you. Do survive this encounter, or you'll become a part of her.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
This transformation, the ascension of such lowly bottom feeders, is a perfect example of how beautiful the depths can be. 'I' has become 'We', and the princess' self-loathing is now ours. This city and her presence will lure more visitors, and 'they' will become 'us'.
Items Required:
Nereid Crown x1 (Stacks up to 5)
Dropped by
Nereid Princess
Rewards:
2,000 Gold
5,000 Exp
Items:
Oxidized Steel
x1
